# Hello there!

> [!NOTE]
> You're creating a pull request against the super standard `ososerp` repository. It's your responsibility to keep this in standard way. Make sure you've reviewed the following checklist before assigning it to a reviewer.

### Description

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Do a **self-review** on your PR, fill in the What, Why section and put a cross [x] in the following checklist.

## Provide the documentation URL [If it is a feature]?

[Provide a confluence URL]

## What did you do in this pull request?

[Please provide a sentence or two describing what the code change does.]

## Why did you make these changes?

[Please provide a detailed explanation of the change.]

## Checklist

<details>
  
  <summary>Common</summary>
  
  - [ ] Added/updated unit tests for your changes
  - [ ] Tested my changes locally
  - [ ] Tested my changes in all supported browsers/environments
  - [ ] Verified my changes meet the acceptance criteria
  - [ ] Verified my changes meet the UI/UX requirements
  - [ ] Considered the impact of my changes on performance, security, and accessibility
  - [ ] Updated JIRA comments with necessary information and screenshots (if applicable)
  - [ ] Updated JIRA comments with other impacted areas

</details>

<details>
  
  <summary>Backend Checklist (If API PRs)</summary>
  
  - [ ] [C# Coding Standard](https://github.com/hassanhabib/CSharpCodingStandard).
  - [ ] Followed the [The Standard](https://github.com/hassanhabib/The-Standard) Architecture.
  - [ ] Added new LifeCycle Attributes to the services.

</details>

<details>
  
  <summary>Frontend Checklist (If UI PRs)</summary>
  
  - [ ] [Angular Naming Conventions](https://gearsjira.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/GEAD/pages/2683961346/Angular+-+Coding+Conventions+Best+Practice)
  - [ ] Used new @if, @for, @switch, signals, instead of older syntax
  - [ ] Used reusable components like osos-button, ososDirection, appRtl and etc.
  - [ ] Used [barrels](https://basarat.gitbook.io/typescript/main-1/barrel) for newly created directives, models, pipes & etc.

</details>

### Happy Coding ≡ƒÆ╗
